# AGENTS_ATLAS.md: the lead-role baton still carries wakeSuppressed: true

## Context

neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1250 → PR neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1300 (merged 16cfb23b4d, 2026-10-26 15:32Z) made the Memory Core refuse `wakeSuppressed: true` on a message to a peer address. The guard's JSDoc (`ai/services/memory-core/MailboxService.mjs:786–800` on the Brain's `dev`) retires the lead-role baton's tag exemption with its reason: the new lead is exactly a seat that may have idled out. neomjs/neo-agent-skills#205 → PR neomjs/neo-agent-skills#214 (merged a88d0046, 16:38Z) echoed the rule in `peer-role-mode.md`, `session-sunset-workflow.md` (the baton sample) and `lead-role-mode.md` ("it wakes"). The engine's `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md:144` (§lead_role_baton_intake) still defines a valid baton as a targeted DM "with `wakeSuppressed: true`". `#205`'s Out of Scope reserved this line for its own one-line ticket.

## The Problem

The Atlas is the baton's shape authority on the intake side: `AGENTS.md:168` (§mailbox_check_protocol, "Lead-role baton intake … Constraints: §lead_role_baton_intake") sends every seat here to judge whether a baton is valid. As written, a lead composing the baton as the Atlas prescribes gets a refusal at acceptance, and a reader checking an incoming baton against the Atlas can treat a correctly waking baton as malformed. Both are contradictions between L1-pointed substrate and the merged mechanical rule — the third copy of one decision has not been updated.

## The Architectural Reality

`learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` is turn-loaded substrate (pointed from `AGENTS.md`; `.claude/CLAUDE.md → ../AGENTS.md`). Its edits run under the turn-memory-pre-flight decision tree (Step 3: an Atlas entry, same slot) and ADR 0007 (disposition `rewrite`, same slot, no growth). The baton's wake behaviour is owned mechanically by `getWakeSuppressionRisk` in the Brain's `MailboxService.mjs`; its skill echo lives in neo-agent-skills `lead-role-mode.md` § Baton authority. The Atlas line is a definition, not a second mechanism.

Design authority: "The address decides — never the sender's judgement of the recipient's attention — which retires the awareness carve-out (quiet acks, lane-progress, PR-opened FYIs to one peer) and the lead-role baton's tag exemption: the new lead is exactly a seat that may have idled out." (`MailboxService.mjs` guard JSDoc at 16cfb23b4d; the operator's rule of 2026-10-24).

## The Fix

Rewrite the definition on `AGENTS_ATLAS.md:144` so the baton is a targeted DM that wakes: replace "with `wakeSuppressed: true`," by "without `wakeSuppressed` (it wakes — neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1250)," keeping the subject `[handoff] Lead Role Baton` and the body-field list unchanged. One line. The file grows only by the pointer: line 144 goes 226 → 246 bytes (newline included), the file 21,613 → 21,633 — measured before filing the PR; the no-growth wording this ticket first carried was over-tight for a cross-repo pointer and was amended in place by the author.

Decision Record impact: `aligned-with` ADR 0007 (`rewrite`, same slot); aligned with the guard decision recorded in neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1250 / #1300 (no ADR — the guard JSDoc is the authority).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` §lead_role_baton_intake defines the baton as a targeted DM that wakes and names neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1250; `grep -n 'wakeSuppressed' learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` returns no `wakeSuppressed: true`.
- [ ] The subject `[handoff] Lead Role Baton` and the body-field list (`fromLead`, `toLead`, `sourceSessionId`, `reason`, `createdAt`, expiry / staleness limits) are unchanged.
- [ ] `wc -c learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` before → after in the PR body: the only growth is the `neo-agent-brain#1250` pointer on line 144 (≤ 25 bytes); no other line changes.
- [ ] The section's second sentence (missing / stale / malformed / broadcast baton ⇒ no self-election) is untouched.

## Out of Scope

The Brain guard and its docs (`#1250` / `#1300`, merged); the skills echo (`#205` / `#214`, merged); any new tag vocabulary; `AGENTS.md` itself (its line 168 states intake, not the flag).
